title: Project scaffold and CI pipeline
user_story: As the team, we want a shared repo layout, config, DB schema and CI so every PR is linted and tested automatically

title: Security core: signed tickets and encrypted PII
user_story: As the facility, we want QR tickets signed with HMAC-SHA256 and PII encrypted with AES-256 so tickets cannot be forged and data leaks expose nothing

title: Immutable audit log
user_story: As a facility manager, I want every override and tariff edit in a write-once tamper-evident log retained for 3 years

title: Staff login with RBAC and admin MFA
user_story: As an admin, I want password + TOTP login and role-based access so only authorised staff can change configuration

title: Backlog GitHub project and PR process
user_story: As the QA lead, I want the backlog, labels, milestones, PR template and automation set up so work is traceable to the SRS

title: Gate hardware simulators
user_story: As a developer, I want ANPR camera, boom barrier, ground loop and printer stubs so the software can be built and tested without physical hardware

title: Nearest vacant slot allocation
user_story: As a driver, I want to be sent to the nearest free bay for my vehicle type (2W/4W/EV/accessible)

title: Slot occupancy sensors and LEDs
user_story: As a driver, I want bay LEDs to turn red within 2 s of a car parking so I can see free bays at a glance

title: VMS availability boards
user_story: As a driver, I want entrance and floor signs to show free spaces within 1 s of a change

title: Edge store-and-forward queue
user_story: As operations, I want lanes to keep working during WAN loss and sync automatically on reconnect

title: Vehicle entry and QR ticket
user_story: As a driver, I want my plate read and a QR ticket issued and the barrier raised in under 3 s

title: Lane safety loop and barrier API
user_story: As a driver, I want the barrier never to come down while my car is under it

title: Entry kiosk and overview UI
user_story: As a driver, I want a kiosk screen that shows my slot, QR ticket and timings

title: Tariff engine with grace period
user_story: As finance, I want fees computed from duration, category and tiered rates with a 15-minute free grace period

title: Exit scan and invoice
user_story: As a driver, I want to scan my ticket or plate at the exit and see my bill within 1 s

title: Cashless payment via gateway webhook
user_story: As a driver, I want to pay by UPI QR, card or wallet; card numbers must never be stored

title: Exit barrier on PAID only
user_story: As security, I want the exit barrier to open only after payment is verified

title: Exit and payment UI
user_story: As a driver, I want an exit screen with the invoice, payment options and receipt

title: Surge pricing and promo coupons
user_story: As the business, I want peak-hour surge rates and promo coupons applied correctly

title: Live display UI
user_story: As a driver, I want to see VMS boards and a live bay map with sensor LEDs

title: 48-hour slot pre-booking
user_story: As a driver, I want to reserve a bay up to 48 hours ahead and receive a reservation code

title: No-show auto release
user_story: As operations, I want unclaimed reservations released 30 minutes after their start time

title: Admin console
user_story: As an admin, I want to change tariffs, surge rules, coupons, zones/slots and staff accounts without a restart

title: Revenue occupancy and turnaround reports
user_story: As a facility manager, I want daily/monthly reports exportable as CSV/PDF in under 5 s

title: Booking and admin UI
user_story: As a driver/admin, I want web pages for booking and for the admin console

title: TLS 1.3 server and dev tooling
user_story: As security, I want the server to accept only TLS 1.3 connections

title: GST tax receipts
user_story: As accounting, I want itemised GST receipts by thermal printer, e-mail or SMS

title: Deviation log
user_story: As the team, we want every deviation from the SRS/SAD/Test Plan written down for the final demo

title: Sprint 1 demo video
user_story: As the evaluator, I want a 1-minute video of the Sprint 1 working product in the repo

title: Edge controller API and WAN simulation
user_story: As an admin, I want to see the offline queue and simulate WAN loss/restore

title: Attendant POS UI
user_story: As an attendant, I want an exceptions desk for alerts, manual entry, cash and audited overrides

title: Resilience and reliability tests
user_story: As QA, I want automated tests for 72 h WAN outage, controller loss, gateway outage and a soak run

title: End-to-end journey tests and Sprint 2 video
user_story: As QA, I want full driver/attendant/admin journeys tested through the API

title: Security validation suite
user_story: As QA, I want TLS handshake, RBAC matrix, PII-at-rest, counterfeit QR and audit tamper tests

title: Performance tests and test reports
user_story: As QA lead, I want NF-001/NF-003 load tests and the unit, system validation, code and branch coverage reports in docs/
